name: agent-tools-dev
cmd: set -euo pipefail; bun --version > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/bun-version.txt"; GDP_WORK_FULL=1 bun test research/agent-tools/protocol.test.ts research/agent-tools/service.test.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/tests.log" 2>&1; bun research/agent-tools/scripted-session.ts --out "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/session.json" > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/session-summary.json"; sha256sum research/agent-tools/*.ts skills/gdp-wired/SKILL.md > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/source-sha256.txt"
